senses.gloss: חִיבֵּץ (cmp. חָבַט) to beat milk &c. into a pulp, to make a pulp, to scramble.
units: Sabb. 95ᵃ; Tosef. ib. IX (X), 13 המְחַבֵּץ והמגבן he who makes thick milk (on the Sabbath, oth. opin. in Rashi: who presses thick milk in a bag to let the fluid run out). Ib. XII (XIII), 14 ובלבד שלא יְחַבֵּץ (Var. יַחְבּוֹץ, v. ed. Zuck. note) provided, he does not beat it into a pulp.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 2:4">T’bul Yom II, 4</cite> <he>אם חי׳</he> if the unclean person stirred (the jelly with the oil on top). Y. Maasr. II, 50ᵃ top; a. e. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:13">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>המחבץ</he>, read: <he>המחמץ</he>.]
